name: Catherine Cortez Masto
committees: Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs
stance: Frames rapidly advancing AI as a growing safety risk — calls for immediate bipartisan AI-safety hearings and a global standard for commonsense guardrails, transparency, and human control.

statements.text: AI development is moving quickly and the safety risks for Americans are also increasing every day.
While these tools hold immense potential, Congress has a role to play to protect Americans from AI-enabled threats ranging from cybercrime to terrorism.
We need global standards for AI safety and transparency to protect workers, our families, and our national security.

review.note: added October 2026 from cortezmasto.senate.gov primary sources; quotes verified verbatim
